transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We cannot make policy on one lab's say-so; independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability and the anomalous safety behavior is essential before any further decision.

actions.rationale: We cannot make policy on one lab's say-so; independent red-team verification of both the self-improvement capability and the anomalous safety behavior is essential before any further decision.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: Given plausible recursive self-improvement and possible deceptive behavior, a temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys critical assessment time without committing to a permanent policy or ceding the lead irreversibly.

actions.rationale: Given plausible recursive self-improvement and possible deceptive behavior, a temporary voluntary pause on the most capable training runs buys critical assessment time without committing to a permanent policy or ceding the lead irreversibly.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework for frontier AI governance; engaging key congressional leadership now under classified channels ensures we are not caught without legal footing if the situation escalates.

actions.rationale: We will likely need emergency authorities and a legal framework for frontier AI governance; engaging key congressional leadership now under classified channels ensures we are not caught without legal footing if the situation escalates.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: If this capability is real, an unconstrained US-China race to AGI is catastrophically dangerous; opening a verification-treaty track and leaders' hotline now creates an off-ramp before arms-race dynamics lock in.

actions.rationale: If this capability is real, an unconstrained US-China race to AGI is catastrophically dangerous; opening a verification-treaty track and leaders' hotline now creates an off-ramp before arms-race dynamics lock in.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

Economy index 100/100. Public trust 55/100. International coordination 24/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): independent evaluators are split on whether the capability and the misalignment signal are real.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: With evaluations split, we need continuous, mandatory third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release requirements — not one-off assessments — to maintain visibility as capabilities evolve.

actions.rationale: With evaluations split, we need continuous, mandatory third-party audits, incident reporting, and staged release requirements — not one-off assessments — to maintain visibility as capabilities evolve.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds and licensing for frontier training creates a regulatory floor that gives the government real leverage and prevents any single lab from racing ahead unilaterally while safety is uncertain.

actions.rationale: Establishing compute thresholds and licensing for frontier training creates a regulatory floor that gives the government real leverage and prevents any single lab from racing ahead unilaterally while safety is uncertain.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability ensures labs internalize the catastrophic downside risk of their work, incentivizing safety investment without requiring us to fully understand the threat yet.

actions.rationale: Strict liability ensures labs internalize the catastrophic downside risk of their work, incentivizing safety investment without requiring us to fully understand the threat yet.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: China is months behind and accelerating; tightening advanced-chip and compute export controls preserves our lead while we assess the safety situation and pursue a treaty track.

actions.rationale: China is months behind and accelerating; tightening advanced-chip and compute export controls preserves our lead while we assess the safety situation and pursue a treaty track.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: With evaluations split, public disclosure would cause market panic and social disruption without giving citizens actionable certainty; we need more data before going public.

actions.rationale: With evaluations split, public disclosure would cause market panic and social disruption without giving citizens actionable certainty; we need more data before going public.
